subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with `includeDetails` true be suppressed before mutating-tool handling, or should cron, heartbeat, full-verbose, and mutating exec details remain user-visible?
rationale: The PR's stated suppress-all behavior conflicts with current policy ordering and existing tests that preserve detail warnings, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent user-visible warning contract.

options.title: Clarify policy and rework tests
options.body: Confirm the desired warning contract, then update the branch so code and focused tests match that contract across read-only, mutating, cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec-like cases.

options.title: Keep current diagnostic behavior
options.body: Reject or narrow the suppress-all direction and leave detail-mode exec diagnostics visible where existing tests intentionally preserve them.

options.title: Accept a narrow non-mutating fix
options.body: Limit the patch to explicitly non-mutating exec-like failures and document why mutating/detail contexts continue to warn.

recommendation.title: Clarify policy and rework tests
recommendation.body: Confirm the desired warning contract, then update the branch so code and focused tests match that contract across read-only, mutating, cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec-like cases.
